premise: Mouse cannot cross the stream; Deer is too tall to help; Beaver builds a little path of sticks and mud.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: not the biggest helper but the right one, and help built to the size of the one who needs it.
lesson: The best help fits the one you're helping.
learning: Beavers build with sticks and mud

en-US.title: Beaver Builds a Way Across
en-US.text: Mouse {mouse:pulse} wanted to visit his grandma on the other side of the stream. But the stream was wide, and Mouse was small. {sfx:stream-bed} Splish, splash, went the water. Deer {deer:pulse} came to help. Hop on my back! But Deer's back was so high that Mouse {mouse:wobble} felt dizzy just looking up. Then Beaver {beaver:hop} popped out of the water. [excited] Leave it to me! He fetched a stick. {beaver:wobble} Then another stick. Then a lump of mud, pat, pat, with his front paws. Stick, stick, mud. Stick, stick, mud. [curious] Can you guess what Beaver was making? A little path, right across the water, just the right size for a mouse! Mouse {mouse:hop x3} scampered over, and Frog {frog:hop} cheered. [happily] And on the other side, Grandma {mouse:hearts} was waiting with a hug.

es-ES.title: Castor construye un camino
es-ES.text: Ratón {mouse:pulse} quería visitar a su abuela, al otro lado del arroyo. Pero el arroyo era ancho, y Ratón era pequeño. {sfx:stream-bed} Chip, chap, hacía el agua. Ciervo {deer:pulse} vino a ayudar. ¡Súbete a mi lomo! Pero su lomo estaba tan alto que a Ratón {mouse:wobble} le daba vueltas la cabeza solo de mirar. Entonces Castor {beaver:hop} salió del agua. [excited] ¡Déjamelo a mí! Trajo un palo. {beaver:wobble} Luego otro palo. Luego un montoncito de barro, pim, pam, con las patas. Palo, palo, barro. Palo, palo, barro. [curious] ¿Adivináis qué estaba haciendo Castor? ¡Un caminito que cruzaba el agua, justo del tamaño de un ratón! Ratón {mouse:hop x3} cruzó correteando, y Rana {frog:hop} aplaudió. [happily] Y al otro lado, la abuela {mouse:hearts} lo esperaba con un abrazo.

stream-bed.prompt: a small babbling forest stream over pebbles, calm
